import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
np.random.seed(42)

print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

train_ids = train_df["id"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

print(f"Training samples: {len(train_ids)}, Test samples: {len(test_ids)}")

X_train_tab = train_df.drop(columns=["id", "species"]).values
X_test_tab = test_df.drop(columns=["id"]).values
y_train = train_df["species"].values

all_species = sample_sub.columns[1:]
n_classes = len(all_species)
print(f"Number of species classes: {n_classes}")


def get_one_hot(label, classes):
    one_hot = np.zeros(len(classes))
    try:
        idx = np.where(classes == label)[0][0]
        one_hot[idx] = 1.0
    except IndexError:
        one_hot[0] = 1.0
    return one_hot


X_train_split, X_val_split, y_train_split, y_val_split = train_test_split(
    X_train_tab, y_train, test_size=0.15, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

print(f"Training split: {len(X_train_split)}, Validation split: {len(X_val_split)}")

y_val_one_hot = np.array([get_one_hot(ys, all_species) for ys in y_val_split])

print("\n=== Training Calibrated Classifier ===")

base_rf = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=300,
    max_depth=30,
    min_samples_split=5,
    min_samples_leaf=2,
    n_jobs=-1,
    random_state=42,
    class_weight="balanced",
)

calibrated_rf = CalibratedClassifierCV(
    base_estimator=base_rf, method="isotonic", cv=3, n_jobs=-1
)
calibrated_rf.fit(X_train_split, y_train_split)

# Extract model's class ordering and build mapping to submission order
model_classes = calibrated_rf.classes_
model_to_submission_idx = {}
for i, species in enumerate(model_classes):
    model_to_submission_idx[species] = np.where(all_species == species)[0][0]

print(f"Model classes: {model_classes}")
print(f"Submission species: {all_species}")
print(f"Class mapping: {model_to_submission_idx}")

# Validate mapping is complete
assert len(model_to_submission_idx) == n_classes, "Class mapping incomplete"

# Get predictions on test data and align columns
test_pred = calibrated_rf.predict_proba(X_test_tab)
test_pred_aligned = np.zeros_like(test_pred)
for i in range(n_classes):
    j = model_to_submission_idx[all_species[i]]
    test_pred_aligned[:, i] = test_pred[:, j]

# Align validation predictions too for consistent scoring
rf_val_pred = calibrated_rf.predict_proba(X_val_split)
rf_val_pred_aligned = np.zeros_like(rf_val_pred)
for i in range(n_classes):
    j = model_to_submission_idx[all_species[i]]
    rf_val_pred_aligned[:, i] = rf_val_pred[:, j]

rf_val_loss = log_loss(y_val_one_hot, rf_val_pred_aligned)
print(f"Aligned Calibrated Random Forest Validation Log Loss: {rf_val_loss:.6f}")

# Get predictions on test data
test_pred = calibrated_rf.predict_proba(X_test_tab)
test_pred_aligned = np.zeros_like(test_pred)
for i in range(n_classes):
    j = model_to_submission_idx[all_species[i]]
    test_pred_aligned[:, i] = test_pred[:, j]

test_pred_aligned = test_pred_aligned / test_pred_aligned.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
test_pred_aligned = np.clip(test_pred_aligned, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

submission = pd.DataFrame()
submission["id"] = test_ids.astype(str)

for i, species in enumerate(all_species):
    submission[species] = test_pred_aligned[:, i]

# Verify submission format
row_sums = submission[submission.columns[1:]].sum(axis=1)
assert all(row_sums > 0.9999) and all(
    row_sums < 1.0001
), "Probabilities do not sum to 1"

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"\n=== SUBMISSION ===")
print(f"Submission saved at ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Submission columns: {list(submission.columns)}")
print(f"Row sums check: min={row_sums.min():.6f}, max={row_sums.max():.6f}")

print(f"\n✅ All done! Validation log loss: {rf_val_loss:.6f}")
